parameters.name: unit_purchase_cost
parameters.description: Unit purchase cost for each raw material

parameters.name: raw_material_availability
parameters.description: Monthly availability limit of each raw material in each period

parameters.name: unit_processing_fee
parameters.description: Unit processing fee for each product

parameters.name: unit_selling_price
parameters.description: Unit selling price for each product

parameters.name: composition_lower_bound
parameters.description: Lower bound on raw-material composition fraction for each raw material-product pair, where specified

parameters.name: composition_upper_bound
parameters.description: Upper bound on raw-material composition fraction for each raw material-product pair, where specified

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Production quantity of each product in each period

variables.name: ingredient_allocation
variables.description: Ingredient allocation of each raw material to each product in each period

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit over the planning horizon

constraints.name: raw_material_availability_limit
constraints.description: Total raw material use in each period cannot exceed the available supply for that raw material and period
constraints.formula: raw material use is bounded by \bar q_{r,t}

constraints.name: composition_lower_bound
constraints.description: When specified, the ingredient allocation for a raw material in a product must satisfy the lower composition requirement

constraints.name: composition_upper_bound
constraints.description: When specified, the ingredient allocation for a raw material in a product must satisfy the upper composition requirement

constraints.name: production_allocation_consistency
constraints.description: Ingredient allocations must be consistent with the production quantity under the composition model
constraints.formula: production and allocation consistency using x_{p,t} and y_{r,p,t}

constraints.name: profit_definition
constraints.description: Define total profit as revenue minus raw-material purchase costs and processing fees over all periods and products.

constraints.name: total_profit_definition
constraints.description: Total profit is a continuous scalar variable used to record the objective value.

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit over the planning horizon

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit over the planning horizon, defined as total revenue from sales minus raw-material purchase costs and processing fees.
